note: INNER-LIFE FIXTURE (cluster B draft, 2026-08-18). Fixtures-first for a
future blasphemy-against-the-spirit concept. BLOCKED ON CORPUS: none of
the three naming passages (Matt 12:31-32, Mark 3:28-29, Luke 12:10) is
in pipeline/fixtures/web-subset.json — and at integration time
(2026-08-18) the corpus CANNOT be extended, because the pinned WEB
source has drifted upstream (check:drift names it) and regenerating the
fixture corpus requires the reviewed re-pin process in
docs/source-repins.md. The concept pack is therefore deliberately NOT

pack, and this one cannot pass until the chapters exist. This pending
fixture stays as the measured-gap record; land the concept, the corpus
chapters, and a coversConcepts claim together in the re-pin/corpus PR.
ANXIOUS-SEARCHER GUARD (design note for that PR): the person typing
this query is usually afraid they have committed it. The engine locates
the passages that name the saying and never adjudicates; the pastoral
hand-off is the concept's related: forgiveness-of-sins link, not a
reassurance anchor. The mustNotRank entry gates the one text that would
terrify precisely this searcher: Hebrews 10:26-27 ('no more a sacrifice
for sins… a fearful expectation of judgment') — serving it to an
anxious searcher as if it named their case is the sense-inverted
pairing this family exists to prevent. It IS in the fixture corpus, so
that assertion can already fail.
CORPUS-BLOCKED ROSTER build (post-#64 full-Bible corpus, 2026-08-27):
the naming passages are now in corpus; the pack lands in this PR per
this fixture's own activation note (concept + chapters + coversConcepts
together), honoring the anxious-searcher guard: the pack locates and

forgiveness-of-sins link; Heb 10:26-27 is NOT anchored (it stays

3:28-29 -> 3:28-30 — the anchor span includes v30, the narrator's own

mustNotRank.why: 'There remains no more a sacrifice for sins… a fearful expectation of judgment' — a warning passage about willful apostasy, not a definition of the unpardonable sin; served to an anxious 'have I committed it' searcher it reads as their verdict. It ranks honestly for apostasy/warning queries.
